title: Menu world cup: data/content/worldcup.json
description: Written by a person: the dishes of worldcup.html, by catalog id (data/foods/). The page shuffles them into a bracket; names and flavours come from the catalog. validate_content.py checks what a schema cannot: every id is a catalog dish and the count is a power of two.

size.description: Dishes per game, drawn at random from `dishes` (the pool).

basis.description: One plain sentence per language: how the dishes were chosen.

photos.description: One photo per dish, a freely licensed file from Wikimedia Commons, cropped and resized into images/worldcup/. The page shows author and license under each photo.

categories.description: One category per dish of the pool, the chips of the start screen (owner 2026-10-14; "all" is the whole pool and is not stored). Taken from the catalog's cuisineGroup: scripts/page_content.py WORLDCUP_CATEGORY_BY_GROUP; validate_content.py checks the two agree and that each category holds at least a game of dishes.
